description: Per-APCore-instance ToggleState isolation (issue #71). Each APCore instance owns one ToggleState, injected into BOTH the toggle module (write path) and the pipeline lookup step (read path). Disabling a module on one instance MUST NOT affect another instance in the same process, and toggle state survives reload of its own instance (A-D-12, re-scoped from process-global to instance-scoped). Runner: construct the named instances in a single process; apply each operation in order through the owning instance's toggle write path; then assert each instance's disabled-set as observed through that instance's read path (the pipeline lookup / is_module_disabled), NOT the process-global fallback. The `reload` action re-registers modules on the instance but MUST preserve its ToggleState. `module_id` values are opaque identifiers the runner may register as no-op modules.
